description.zh:
服务类型：
- **antcloudauth**：金融级实人认证。
- **cloudauthst**（已退市）：实人认证增强版。
description.en:
The service type. Valid values:
- **antcloudauth**: financial-grade ID Verification.
- **cloudauthst** (discontinued): enhanced ID Verification.

description.zh: 时间段范围，搜索范围为前N天，TimeRange为1表示前1天。
description.en: The time range. The search scope is the previous N days. For example, a value of 1 indicates the previous day.

title.zh: 按照个体性别统计认证信息
title.en: Query ID verification statistics by gender

descriptions.zh:
- 服务地址：cloudauth.aliyuncs.com。
- 请求方法：HTTPS POST和GET。
descriptions.en:
- Service endpoint: cloudauth.aliyuncs.com.
- Request method: HTTPS POST and GET.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudauth describe-verify-personas-sex-statistics --scene-id 1000002996 --product-code ID_PRO --time-range 7 --service-code antcloudauth --api-version 2019-03-07 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudauth DescribeVerifyPersonasSexStatistics --region cn-hangzhou --SceneId 1000002996 --TimeRange 7 --ServiceCode antcloudauth --ProductCode ID_PRO
